itemDesc.650: A Distortion World BALL that never runs out. It catches like a GREAT BALL, and fades after 24 hours.
itemDesc.651: One sniff and a Pokémon's stats grow as if it had the nature you pick. Used up after one sniff.
itemDesc.652: Makes one stat you pick as good as it can be: a perfect 31 IV.
itemDesc.653: Makes all six of a Pokémon's stats as good as they can be: perfect 31 IVs.
itemDesc.654: Swaps a Pokémon between its species' two normal Abilities.
itemDesc.655: Gives a Pokémon its species' rare hidden Ability, in worlds that have hidden Abilities.
itemDesc.656: Moves a Pokémon you pick into a new ball. Its record stays just as it was.
itemDesc.657: Held at the Day Care: passes on its nature and five stats. An Everstone and a Destiny Knot in one.
itemDesc.658: A warm wrap. While it's in your Bag, Eggs hatch faster. Flame Body makes them faster still.
itemDesc.659: Held by the first Pokémon in your team: wild Pokémon always share its nature.
itemDesc.660: Lasts 200 steps: wild Pokémon are ten times likelier to have their hidden Ability, in worlds that have them.
itemDesc.661: While it's in your Bag, Pokémon earn 1.5 times the EXP. USE it to turn it ON or OFF.
itemDesc.662: Lasts 200 steps: wild Pokémon and Eggs are likelier to be shiny. Works with the Shiny Charm.
